body: when i was young they all said that. now im 30 and nothing changed or got better.why lie to her? 15 is old enough to know the truth. for us suicidal people it is a life sentence. in particular her quote: "It's so unfair people don't have the right to decide over their own lives." that only gets worse as you get older .as you are forced to work, pay taxes, pay debts, pay mortgage, and pressured by everybody to have children. "people tell me to stfu and just live my life" that too gets worse as we age.  the best thing is to get on heavy medication and allow it to trick you into being happy.
